ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the B3-1,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-F in the
area bound by:

      South Union Avenue; the public alley next north of and parallel to West 95th Street; a line
      144.8 feet east of and parallel to South Union Avenue; West 95th Street

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ___________________________
                                                           Ronnie Mosley
                                                           Alderman, 21st Ward




Common Address:
646 W. 95th Street
